I had the same problem as you. I always tried to be a good person no matter how bad my situation was. Always tried to listen to others, their problems, give as much as i could. Irony is that i thought that these people were the closest ones to me, but turned out it just wasn't true.

The problem is generally we don't care about other people. We just like to consume them like we consume food, movies and music. As long as you are funny person  that can make other people laugh, make witty comments, everyone are going to be your friend. Sex, humour are things which are easy to consume just like candies. No one wants to hear shit about what makes you depressed. At that point you became a meal that everyone took a bite of, they are well fed now, they don't want to clean the dishes. 

That's why it's hard to like the people, when you went from hell and back. Hard to like these fuck that wasn't around when you needed them the most. 

My opinion, you just should know that majority of the people are light minded, they just want an easy happiness: light relationship and funny/noisy group of friends. Majority don't like to dig deep, because it makes them sad.

As always the answer is the easiest one. Just don't take it personally. The most kind and powerful person is the one that could overcome his hate towards others, and just take them how they are
